steps.text: 1/8 cup shredded mozzarella to a bowl
Slice two 1/2 inch thick rounds from a baguette (slice slanted)
Brush 2 slices of baguette with olive oil on both sides
Cut 1/4 cup of cherry tomatoes into halves
In a bowl, add the cut cherry tomatoes
Combine the contents of the bowl
Toast both sides of the slices on the pan for 2 to 3 minutes until lightly charred and crispy and transfer the slices to a plate
Spoon the mixture from the bowl onto the bread
